summary: Implemented load_decathalon_datalist as specified. Added monai/data/decathalon_dataloader.py (loader plus private _resolve_path helper, standard library only), an explicit export in monai/data/__init__.py, a "Decathalon DataLoader" autofunction subsection in docs/source/data.rst after Utilities, and tests/test_load_decathalon_datalist.py with class TestLoadDecathalonDatalist (test_seg_values, test_cls_values, test_seg_no_basedir, test_seg_no_labels). Nothing was run and nothing was committed. Line lengths were checked by awk (none over 120), but black and flake8 were not run, so the formatting gate is unconfirmed. The list-valued path behaviour is implemented but has no test, since the spec only requires scalar paths in test_seg_values.
